title: 487 days alcohol free thanks to this app
body: Such a simple concept but it works surprisingly well. I find being able to see the days a big motivator. Today marks 487 days I cold quit alcohol and seeing the numbers go up on the app makes me even more motivated to the point the sight or smell of alcohol makes me feel genuinely disgusted. I’m 4 days into cold quitting weed, can’t wait to rack the numbers up and get it completely out of my life. AMAZING and SIMPLE TO USE APP that DOESN’T TAKE UP A LOT OF TIME. I’m wondering what to quit next 😃.

title: Excellent
body: I couldn't ask for more from a habit tracker. It's absolutely free to use with no ads which shows that the developers truly care about the app. It's also very easy to use and so aesthetically appealing. You can add as many trackers as you want for whatever habit you want to stop or start. The app has really helped me stop some old habits and every time I look at how far I have come, i feel proud of myself. Would recommend.
